messages:
aria: heads-up — since ~08:20 we've had a sustained stream of small prefill requests hitting reserved-gpu-pool-3. max_batch=64 + continuous tiny prefills is making the batcher wait and we're missing p95/p99 SLOs for text-gen.
aria: quick metric: `prod.batch.wait_time{pool:reserved-gpu-pool-3}.rollup(p99,1m)` spiked to ~420ms and GPU queue depth steady at 85%.
aria: grafana: https://grafana.prod/redwood/d/ABCD/prod-batching?from=now-2h (see p99 wait, queue depth)
kevin: any scheduled node drains or autoscaler churn in that pool?
mike: there was a kernel-rollout on 3 nodes in us-west-2 at 07:55 that went into DRAIN -> rebalancing + packing fragmentation ~+18%.
mike: that fragmentation means we can't co-pack many small requests so small-prefill items sit waiting for a max_batch fill.
lina: if we lower max_batch to 32 for this pool we'll cut wait-time but drop throughput and increase per-token GPU secs. cost tradeoff.
eng-runtime-oncall: oncall: I'm going to try a config canary on one shard: `/rollout batcher-config pool=reserved-gpu-pool-3 shard=shard-12 max_batch=32 prefill_timeout_ms=25`
aria: ack. please watch p50/p95 token latency and throughput. We want latency SLOs back without blowing up cost.
sre-bot: ALERT: latency_slo_miss count increased by 320 in last 15m for route `/v1/generate` (us-west-2, pool reserved-gpu-pool-3)
kevin: also check admission qps limits — our admission controller is currently allowing many small requests that trip the packer. Maybe add a tiny async-prefill path that bypasses max_batch waiting for requests < 32 tokens.
lina: good idea — a short-circuit for <=32-token requests. But need to audit correctness for tool-calling and KV cache assumptions.
mike: short-term: canary applied. eng-runtime-oncall: what's the observed impact?
eng-runtime-oncall: canary results after 4min: p99 batch wait down from 420ms -> 60ms on shard-12, overall pool p99 fell ~120ms. throughput on shard-12 down ~8%.
aria: that looks promising. if we roll to 4/12 shards we should hit region-level SLOs back.
kevin: schedule: roll to 4 shards now, monitor 15m, then decide autoscaler bump if still high.
lina: note: autoscaler spin-up to add 2 gpus in reserved-gpu-pool-3 is ~9-12min; cost delta estimated +$1.7k/day.
kevin: fine for today while we debug admission logic. make a follow-up ticket to adjust packer algorithm to prefer filling from multiple shards rather than single-shard max_batch waits.
aria: created ticket INF-4852 with notes + screenshots. Let’s reconvene after 30m metric window.
eng-runtime-oncall: rolled to 4 shards at 09:02. monitoring.
kevin: thanks all. if p99 starts rising again, we may need temporary regional routing to us-east-1 for heavy customers until fragmentation cleared.
aria: noted — I'll prep a short runbook for oncall to flip routing for top-10 tenants if needed. :clipboard:
eng-runtime-oncall: closing loop: will post a postmortem if we don't have a sustained fix in 48h.
